_preprocessor_name_help: Optional. Class in preprocessor.py to use; only needed if it defines more than one BasePreprocessor subclass.
_model_params_help: Kwargs passed directly to the model constructor (the class named by 'model_name' in model.py). Model-specific; do not put any key here that the constructor does not accept.
_model_preprocessing_help: Passed whole to the preprocessor's constructor (available as self.config); it configures BOTH preprocess() and postprocess(). Contents are model-specific.

metadata._help: Free-form apart from 'task'. Use it to record how the model was trained and any assumptions it makes.
metadata._task_help: What the model does. Read by list_local_models(); falls back to the 'dosecalc-*'/'outcome-*' repository-name prefix when absent. Distinct from the radiation modality under 'training'.
metadata.description: Short human-readable description of the model.

training.notes: How the data was trained / assumptions the model makes.
